text:
Matthew Knies has a new home and, apparently, a score to settle. The Maple Leafs drafted him 57th overall in 2021 and gave him 240 games before he landed in Columbus, and when he went back to Toronto he scored in a comeback win and told reporters, "That was personal for me." A teammate came out in strong support.

Through 22 games as a Blue Jacket he has six goals and 14 points at 18:35 a night. The finishing is honest, six goals on 5.5 expected, and the Blue Jackets' share of expected goals is a bit better with him on (1.5 points). He's a physical winger, 41 hits, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking finds an unusual signature: 18% of his setups come from behind the net, more than double a typical forward. Goalies have to turn and find the puck on those. Our range projects 52 to 74 points. Whether the best is yet to come, as one headline asked, depends on whether Columbus gives him a top-line centre.
